description: Get your Untappd friend activity feed — the recent check-ins from people you follow, newest first. Page backwards with max_id (the pagination.max_id from a prior call). Read-only.

max_id.description: Return check-ins older than this id (for paging)

view.description: Response shape: "compact" (default) projects each check-in to {id, user, beer, brewery, venue, rating, comment, toast/comment counts}; "full" returns Untappd's whole ~5 KB record; "brief" returns one line per check-in: <user>: <beer> (<brewery>) at <venue> — <ISO date or "no date"> — <rated N|not rated>, inside the untrusted-data envelope as data: string[], with "-- " note lines ("-- none", "-- more").

name: untappd_activity_feed
title: Get Untappd friend activity feed
